Subject: Contract closure orchestration — MSA redlines & PO timeline

Sean / Laura / Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — StellarHealth is aligned to move forward pending a couple of procurement/legal items. Attaching a short RFP summary and our procurement checklist to make the path to PO as visible as possible (attachment: StellarHealth_RFP_summary.pdf).

High level asks from our side:
- MSA redline review: our legal team added a handful of comments on data handling and incident reporting (see attached redline).
- Order form: we need a final SKU-level order form + lead times for provisioning dedicated capacity.
- Vendor setup: vendor questionnaire and W9 for finance.

Can you confirm a MAP with owners and an estimated close timeline? We are targeting contract signature + PO by Dec 22 to hit our Q1 planning.

Best,
Maya Johnson
Sr. Procurement Manager
StellarHealth

Maya, thanks for the clear checklist — appreciate the timeline. I put together a short MAP and attached a working spreadsheet (MAP_v1.xlsx) that breaks down milestones, owners, and dates. Quick summary below:

Proposed MAP highlights:
- Legal redline turnaround (initial response): Karthik (target 2 business days) — 2026-12-10
- Order form finalization / pricing confirmation: Laura (target 3 business days) — 2026-12-11
- Vendor setup (W9, PO creation): Neha (coordinate with Stellar finance) — target PO issuance by 2026-12-22
- Provisioning: Dedicated capacity typically within 5 business days of PO receipt; we'll flag a short-burst allocation for your kickoff.

I'll assign items in the spreadsheet and set an internal triage tomorrow morning. Karthik — can you prioritize the redline and call out any non-negotiable language we need to escalate? Laura — can you confirm the SKU lead times and whether we need any additional approvals for the committed capacity?

I'll keep this thread as weekly checkpoint updates and copy Stellar's procurement/legal leads.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com

From: Tom Armitage <t.armitage@stellarhealth.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Maya Johnson <maya.johnson@stellarhealth.com>, legal@stellarhealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: MSA redline (attached)

Forwarding our legal team's redline — see MSA_Stellar_Redline.docx. A few notes from their reviewer:

- Section 4 (Data Security): they want explicit language on tables/keys retention and our obligation window for key rotation notices.
- Section 9 (Incident Reporting): 24-hour initial notification plus 72-hour detailed report requested (they prefer contractual language around SLAs for incident closure).
- Limitation of liability: pushback on the cap in a few failure modes.

We expect a point-by-point response. Also: finance expects a completed vendor setup form (we can send the template if helpful).

Thanks,
Tom
Director, Legal Operations
StellarHealth

Attachment: MSA_Stellar_Redline.docx (redlined changes)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Contract closure orchestration — MSA redlines & PO timeline

Sean / Laura — reviewed Tom's redline. High level responses and proposed edits are attached (Redwood_Responses_to_Redline.pdf). Key points: 

1) Data/security (Section 4):
- We can commit to documented key rotation notices and retention windows. Propose adding a 45-day notice for rotation events and explicit retention tables in an addendum; this is operationally feasible.

2) Incident reporting (Section 9):
- We accept 24-hour initial notice and will provide a 72-hour investigative summary where feasible. Suggest adding language that investigative timelines are subject to data access constraints; we will offer a remediation timeline SLA in the added exhibit.

3) Limitation of liability:
- Will not be able to remove caps entirely; propose a higher cap tied to net fees for the prior 12 months for certain security incidents. Flagging this one for escalation to Product / Finance if Stellar cannot accept.

Action items from legal triage:
- Karthik to deliver tracked-change MSA with counter-proposals by EOD 2026-12-11.
- Laura to confirm final SKU pricing and whether a one-off procurement discount needs leadership approval (due 2026-12-11).
- Neha to prepare vendor setup packet and W9; will share with Maya for finance (due 2026-12-13).

I will keep the redline responses concise and provide clause-level rationale where we request different language. If Stellar insists on removing the liability cap we should escalate — Sean, please flag during your commercial sync.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Responses_to_Redline.pdf (summary + clause proposals)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Johnson <maya.johnson@stellarhealth.com>, Tom Armitage <t.armitage@stellarhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -0800

Maya / Tom — thanks for the rapid turnaround. Quick checkpoint and confirmed MAP items below (finalized entries also in MAP_v1.xlsx in the shared drive):

Confirmed timelines:
- 2026-12-11: Redwood delivers tracked-change MSA with counter-proposals (Karthik) — done, sent to Tom earlier today.
- 2026-12-11: SKU & order form agreed by commercial (Laura) — Laura attached a draft order form; I'll link the DocuSign in this thread.
- 2026-12-13: Vendor setup package & W9 (Neha) — Neha will send package to Maya; please confirm vendor form receipts.
- 2026-12-22: Target date for PO issuance by StellarFinance to hit provisioning window.
- Provisioning estimate: 5 business days after PO; we will queue a short-burst allocation to ensure availability for your kickoff week.

Action owners & open items:
- Karthik: escalate limitation-of-liability counterproposal only if Stellar cannot accept the net-fees-linked cap (owner: Karthik).
- Laura: finalize order form and confirm committed capacity SKU lead times (owner: Laura).
- Neha: confirm vendor onboarding form and send W9 (owner: Neha).
- Maya/Tom: confirm if Stellar legal will accept Redwood's incident-reporting exhibit language or needs an alternate timeline (owner: Stellar legal).

Attachments included for convenience: OrderForm_Stellar_DocuSign.pdf (DocuSign package link: https://www.docusign.com/OrderForm/evt/8743). If everything looks good I will lock the MAP and set weekly checkpoint cadence (Tuesdays 10:00 PT) until signature and PO.

Looking forward to closing this out — Sean will be available for a short commercial sync tomorrow if helpful.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
